title: Using AI in the interview process
content:
# Using AI in the interview process

At GitLab, we embrace AI to help our teams work better and faster while following our CREDIT values and AI Ethics Principles. Similar to how we integrate AI into our products to support customers throughout the software development lifecycle, we also encourage our teams, and candidates, to use AI thoughtfully to boost productivity and drive better outcomes.

## Our AI ethics principles in talent acquisition

We leverage AI powered technology that is tested to prevent bias.

We protect candidate information and ensure any AI powered technology meet GitLab's security standards.

We evaluate how AI can impact candidates and avoid implementations that could cause unintentional harm.

We carefully evaluate what data is used by AI, how it is used, and ensure comprehensive compliance with privacy commitments.

Our AI-assisted recruitment processes include meaningful human review, feedback mechanisms, and continuous improvement.

## How we view AI

We view AI as a powerful enhancement to human capabilities while recognizing that understanding potential, building relationships, and making fair hiring decisions remain fundamentally human activities. We do not leverage AI for decision making in our hiring process and recognize the importance of human-centric activities in our recruitment lifecycle.

In line with our AI Ethics Principles, our Talent Acquisition team uses AI in the following ways:

### Content creation

* **Job descriptions:** We may use AI to help draft job descriptions that are then reviewed and refined by our hiring teams.
* **Interview questions:** We may use AI to help generate relevant interview questions that align with the role requirements to provide efficient, structured interview processes.
* **Sourcing messages:** We may use AI to draft initial outreach messages that are then personalized by our recruiters.

### Process enhancement

* **Interview summaries:** With appropriate consent, we may use AI to help summarize interview feedback, reducing the burden on interviewers while ensuring comprehensive documentation.
* **Analytics:** We use AI to analyze recruitment metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.

### Human oversight

* **Human review:** All AI-generated content undergoes meaningful human review before use.
* **Decision-making:** Hiring decisions are always made by human team members.
* **Regular bias review:** We regularly review our AI policies in Talent Acquisition to ensure they test for potential bias.

## Our guiding principles for candidates

Learn how we use AI to enhance our interview process while keeping people at the centre of hiring decisions. We'll share our ethical guidelines, what to expect during interviews, and how you can transparently leverage AI as a candidate in the interview process.

## AI Use Guidelines By Stage

You may use AI to assist with your resume or cover letter, but the information must accurately represent your qualifications and skills.

# Staff Mobile Engineer - React Native (x/f/m)

Unlimited Contract

Engineering

Paris, France

## About Doctolib

At Doctolib, we’re reinventing the daily lives of health professionals and empowering people to live healthier across Europe.

More than 3,000 Doctolibers across France, Germany, Italy, the UK and the Netherlands are building a new generation of AI-powered technologies and services, trusted by 520 000 health professionals and over 90 million patients every day.

AI is at the heart of how we build and how we work. At Doctolib, AI fluency is a core skill for every team member: we foster a culture leveraging AI to drive efficiency, quality, and impact at scale.

## Job description

## What you'll do

We are looking for a Staff Mobile Engineer with strong expertise in React Native to join our Patient domain at Doctolib.

As a Mobile Staff Engineer, your mission will be to work on transforming the Doctolib mobile app into a full health companion powered by AI to help people lead healthier lives. You will play a key role in improving the quality, UX, and depth of our mobile application while contributing significantly to the technical foundations of mobile development for the team.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Establish and evolve mobile architecture patterns and technical standards for the patient domain
* Drive technical excellence across mobile development, ensuring high code quality and best practices
* Contribute to the technical roadmap and guide architectural decisions for the mobile platform
* Mentor and support mobile engineers in implementing robust, scalable solutions
* Lead by example in building features that enhance the user experience and app performance

### About our tech environment

* Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. To address these challenges, we are modularizing our platform run in a distributed architecture through reusable components.
* Our mobile applications are built with React Native. The rest of our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python and Kotlin.
* We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here and learn about our first AI hackathon here!

## Who you are

Before you read on — if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

# Senior Software Engineer, Aiven ContextHelsinki, Uusimaa, Finland

Apply now

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

### **The Role:**

The team's mission is to build the definitive AI-Native Open Source Data Platform. They are integrating best-of-breed open-source technologies - starting with data governance and discovery (DataHub) and moving into unified federated querying - to deliver a seamless data experience in minutes, not months.

They aren't a typical corporate team. They operate like an early-stage startup inside Aiven: they move fast, iterate rapidly, and default to extreme ownership. Senior Software Engineers don't just own a product surface from ideation to production - they shape how the team builds, help resolve the hardest technical problems, and raise the bar for everyone around them.

### **The AI-First Mindset**

They aren't just building for an AI-first future; they live in it. They expect candidates to be AI-First Engineers. This means actively using LLMs and agentic workflows to supercharge daily coding, automate mundane tasks, and optimize deployment pipelines. Senior engineers are also expected to bring this mindset to the team - identifying where AI-driven workflows can multiply the team's output and helping others adopt them.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Own the Stack (Backend to Console):** Act as a true full-stack engineer across backend services written in Python and the user-facing web flows within the React-based Aiven Console, taking on the most architecturally significant and ambiguous parts of the system.
* **Drive Technical Direction:** Work on complex, open-ended problems where the right approach isn't obvious - evaluate variable factors, choose methods and techniques, and define the patterns and standards the rest of the team builds on.
* **Launch & Maintain Managed OSS Products:** Lead the technical design and delivery of new managed services like DataHub on Aiven, and help build out the context layer offering as it matures.
* **Mentor and Raise the Bar:** Review designs and code, advise other engineers on complex technical matters, and help less experienced team members grow.
* **Contribute Back to the Community:** Give back to the ecosystem by upstreaming bug fixes, optimizations, and feature enhancements to original open-source projects whenever possible.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer | Jobs at Peratera
content:
# Senior Frontend Engineer

Remote Global

Full-time

Permanent employee

## About Us

Peratera is a UK-based fintech company, founded in 2022 and authorised by the FCA as an Electronic Money Institution.

We are building a modern, all-in-one payment platform that enables businesses to manage global payments and financial operations seamlessly.

Our solution allows companies to open multi-currency accounts, send and receive payments worldwide, and manage cross-border transactions from a single platform.

Our mission is to simplify global finance and remove friction from international business operations.

## Your mission

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will be part of the team building and evolving the user-facing applications behind our financial platform.

  

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will develop new functionality, improve existing solutions, and contribute to frontend architecture and technical decisions. You will work closely with Backend Engineers and Product to deliver reliable and intuitive experiences for users managing financial operations.

## Your Tech Environment

You will work across a modern frontend stack alongside existing platform components:

* Frontend: Angular 22, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML, CSS
* Existing Components: jQuery 3.7.0, Materialize, funnelEvents.js, bankElements.js
* Backend: PHP 8.3.26, CodeIgniter 3.1.8
* Data & Infrastructure: MySQL 8.0, Redis 7.4

## What You’ll Do

* Own frontend development from technical design through implementation, testing, and production delivery
* Build and evolve user-facing applications for payments, accounts, transactions, and other financial workflows
* Develop reusable UI components and features using Angular, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
* Translate product and business requirements into clear technical solutions and pragmatic frontend implementations
* Contribute to frontend architecture, technical decisions, and the evolution of shared frontend patterns and standards
* Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services, working closely with Backend Engineers on API contracts and end-to-end functionality
* Work with existing production codebases, improving legacy components while introducing modern frontend solutions where appropriate
* Identify and address frontend issues related to performance, reliability, security, and user experience
* Write well-tested code and participate in code reviews, debugging, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing
* Collaborate with Product, UX/UI, QA, and DevOps to deliver features from initial requirements through production

## What We’re Looking For

* 5+ years of professional experience in frontend engineering
* Strong hands-on experience with modern Angular and React, including Angular 16+ and React 17+
* Proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a solid understanding of component-based frontend architecture
* Experience building complex interfaces and reusable

# Staff Engineer - Customer Interfaces

Development San Francisco

**This is Adyen**

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

**Staff Engineer - Customer Interfaces**

As a Staff Engineer for Customer Interfaces (CI), you will lead the evolution of the Adyen experience from a traditional dashboard into an intelligent, conversational financial partner.

We are looking for a product engineer who can wear an architectural hat to build Agentic Workflows and manage backend orchestration (specifically Tool-use, Chains, and Policy Layers). This role is essential for transforming natural language inputs into authenticated, secure financial operations.

**What you'll do**

* **Drive Intelligent Experiences:** Lead the next generation of conversational UIs at Adyen. You will build Generative UIs that adapt in real-time, moving beyond static dashboards to create streaming, multi-modal experiences where the interface itself is a dynamic partner in the conversation.
* **Bridge Architecture & Innovation:** Act as the primary technical liaison for AI initiatives, coordinating their integration and ensuring operational excellence with teams in different areas and global geographies. You will ensure that "intelligent modules" built in are the gold standard for performance and extensibility.
* **Zero-Trust for AI:** Architect the security layer for conversational interfaces. You will solve the unique challenge of maintaining strict financial data privacy and "Zero Trust" principles while leveraging LLMs and advanced data processing.
* **Product Strategy & "The Art of the Possible":** Partner deeply with the Head of Product to identify high-impact flows. You aren't just implementing designs; you are identifying where intelligent automation can solve "impossible" merchant problems.
* **Full-Stack Leadership:** Own the end-to-end technical lifecycle. From backend services and data pipelines that feed our insights, to the frontend components that render them.
* **Global Influence:** Mentor engineers and coordinate with global hubs to drive technical standards that benefit the entire Adyen ecosystem.

#### **Who you are**

## The Role

**The role**

As an Associate Engineer, you will help supercharge small businesses by writing clean, reliable code and delivering well-defined features that directly support our product outcomes. Working alongside senior engineers, you will solve day-to-day technical challenges, design tests to ensure high quality, and debug code using logs and dashboards to maintain system health.

By bringing curiosity and a data-driven mindset, you will help keep our systems robust and aligned with customer needs. You will take ownership of your work, proactively share knowledge, and contribute to a supportive, inclusive environment where continuous learning drives success.

**The team & how they connect**

Our engineering teams work collaboratively to build and maintain scalable technology for small businesses. We value open communication, thoughtful discussion, and working together across functions to remove blockers and solve problems efficiently.

**The team is currently working on**

* Developing front end features using HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6+) with React
* Integrating front end applications with back end REST APIs
* Utilising modern delivery and collaboration practices such as pair programming and continuous improvement
* Exploring artificial intelligence tools to increase efficiency and automate routine tasks

**Where and how you can work**

We support a flexible working model that empowers you to balance your professional and personal life. You will have the option to work in a hybrid capacity, combining the focus of remote work with the collaboration of our office spaces and team boost days to foster connection and alignment.

**Here are some of the things we are looking for**

* Hands-on experience building web applications using modern JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
* Practical exposure to React and an understanding of connecting front end interfaces to REST APIs
* Comfort navigating version control using Git and participating in pull request code reviews
* A sharp eye for UI/UX details, quality standards, and confidence debugging code locally
* Curiosity about leveraging AI tools to streamline everyday workflows and tasks
* Familiarity with TypeScript, testing frameworks (like Jest or Cypress), component libraries, or web accessibility principles is a plus
